title: B-roll every 5 minutes
description: Every five minutes: read the wave, record 20 seconds of anchored-window footage for b-roll, and append a row to the b-roll spreadsheet. Higher priority than the 30s stat tick — stats wait while recording.
notes: Clips land in runs/clips/broll_run_{n}_wave_{w}_{timestamp}.mp4. CSV: runs/stat_broll.csv. Does not touch upgrade tabs. Requires ffmpeg on PATH.

actions.description: Read-only panel status before recording (leave upgrade menu as-is).
Read the wave used in the clip filename and CSV row.
Announce the recording in the console.
Record 20 seconds of the anchored window to runs/clips/.
Append datetime, run, wave, clip name/path/duration, and panel status to runs/stat_broll.csv.
